name: SR-410E
description: "A record player with photoelectric servos.The drive mechanism uses a direct drive system.A photoelectric servo system is used in the servo circuit of this mechanism. This speed control system is equipped with a striped slit plate that rotates simultaneously with the turntable. This slit plate is sandwiched between a light projecting part and a light receiving part. The photosensitive element CDs in the light receiving part detects the interruption of light caused by the rotation of the slit and detects a pulse. This pulse is amplified, the waveform is adjusted by a multivibrator, and integrated into a DC voltage. description: "This is a speaker system using C. R. polymer that inherits the design philosophy of the SS-F50 and integrates it into a compact design.C. R. polymer is a special rigid foam. R. polymer diaphragm employs a triangular truss structure in which the voice coil bobbin that drives the central part of the diaphragm and the outermost periphery of the diaphragm are fixed by a subcone. R. polymer is installed in the low range.It uses a damper made of Conex material and urethane edge with excellent linearity to suppress vibration of the diaphragm. description: "A three way speaker system that uses a flat diaphragm made of C. R. polymer.The C. R. Polymer (Cell Rigid Polymer) developed by Rolex is a special rigid foam. name: SD-77
description: "A channel divider that employs an arithmetic circuit method that creates high-pass and low-pass characteristics in a single circuit.The calculation circuit is of the double integral and subtraction type. This method has been used in the field of measuring instruments. It is possible to produce both low-pass and high-pass characteristics simultaneously with one circuit. Moreover, the obtained change characteristic is symmetrical around the cross point. Even if the slope characteristic or Q characteristic is changed, this characteristic does not change. The sum of the voltages is always kept at 0 dB, and smooth connection with no phase shift is obtained.A class A DC operational amplifier IC is used as the active element, so that a large bare gain can be obtained and the so-called bounce characteristics can be suppressed to a practically negligible level, resulting in ideal damping characteristics.A discrete configuration is used for the mixer section and excellent characteristics are obtained.The cutoff characteristics can be switched between 6dB/oct. and 12dB/oct.In the SD-77, the operation section for determining the crossover frequency is independent. The frequency varies depending on the capacitance and gain. However, by setting the capacitance to a constant value, the frequency can be determined only by changing the resistance of the gain control. This allows the crossover to be continuously variable.The volume uses a 22-contact detent type high-precision metal-coated volume with 22 points for switching between high and low frequencies.By changing the damping characteristic (Q characteristic), it is possible to change the damping characteristic near the cutoff frequency.It can also be used as a 2-channel Divider by using only one of the low and high crossover points.Equipped with independent level control for each band of low, middle and high.A buffer amplifier is provided at the output stage.The protective resistor of 100 � becomes the output impedance as it is.A reed relay with a high operating speed is used to prevent click noise when the power switch is turned ON/OFF.By attaching the separately sold Carrying Handle TO-1, it can be mounted on a 480 mm width JIS standard rack."

name: XD-80
description: "This digital recording processor realizes high-quality PCM (Pulse Code Modulation) recording and playback by combining it with a home VTR.In PCM, analog signals are digitally encoded and recorded on tape. Based on the EIAJ standard specifications, the original signal is sampled into 44,056 kHz pulses and the pulses are quantized. This realizes a dynamic range of more than 85 dB, characteristics of frequencies from 10 Hz to 20 kHz, a low distortion rate of less than 0.015%, 0 wow / flutter in practical use, and channel separation of more than 85 dB.As a drop-out countermeasure, the XD-80 additionally records two correction codes (P code and Q code) and CRCC (error detection code) for every six data items during recording.When a drop-out occurs during playback, errors are detected by the triple error detection method, which adds the H correlation data check method in addition to the syndrome check using CRCC check and EIAJ standard relational equation, and accurate correction is performed by the double correction function using two correction codes.In addition, if uncorrectable data occurs, a correction process is performed using the average value of the previous and next correct data, and an operation called interleaving is performed to prevent data from being lost due to concentration.Variable speed playback such as cue / review (approx. 20 x) / 2 x / 3 x / slow, which was impossible with the conventional PCM method, is possible. Still sound playback is also possible, making accurate head-tracking possible.These functions are realized by a powerful anomaly detection circuit, a harmful signal rejection circuit, and a multiple PLL control system for generating the clock necessary for data and synchronizing signal separation.You can connect two VTR decks and make digital copies.It is possible to mix digital code reproduced by VTR with digital code of recorded input.Equipped with a REC mute mechanism that is convenient for creating unrecorded space between songs when recording, or for cutting out unnecessary parts while copying. Since REC mute is done with digital signals, it is not affected by analog noise.An emphasis circuit is built into the amplifier that handles analog signals during recording and playback. The emphasis circuit is applied to signals of 400 Hz or higher, and it performs high-frequency compensation of approximately 10 dB at 10 kHz.Since the emphasis circuit can be turned ON / OFF with a switch, it can be used depending on the recording source.Equipped with a level meter, the meter mode selector switch allows you to display the VTR tracking status during playback. This allows you to easily adjust the tracking to the best possible level by simply maximizing the meter display.Equipped with an automatic mode selector (AMS) circuit. There are two VTR input jacks, one for playback and one for copying. When a video input signal is input to the duplicate input, mixing / duplicating (copying) is automatically enabled. When there is no signal in the duplicate input, normal mode is automatically enabled again.You can switch between mixing and copying at the position of the master volume. When the volume is closed, the volume is copied. At other positions, the volume is set to mixing standby. An indicator shows the status of each of these.During digital duplication (copy) or digital mixing operation, the digital attenuator of 6 dB can be turned ON / OFF for playback digital data, and the master volume can be used to fade in and out the recording source without changing the recording level.The presence or absence of emphasis, copy prohibition, and operation status of parity (correction signal) Q are indicated by indicators.These digital signals recorded on the tape are automatically detected during playback and the indicator lights.Equipped with a headphone port with a dedicated volume.Because the pulse played on a VTR is severely distorted compared to the recorded signal produced in a PCM processor, if the slice level that determines the 0 and 1 of the pulse is too high or too low, an accurate pulse cannot be reproduced.To solve this problem, the XD-80 has an Automatic Data Slice Level Detector Control (ADSD) circuit that automatically adjusts the slice level to the best possible level for stable data extraction.An ASSC (Analog Sync Slice Level Control) circuit is mounted to prevent timing deviation due to distortion of the sync (sync signal) caused by noise in the reproduced signal.In this circuit, the slice level is automatically controlled to the optimum level and this timing gap is suppressed.For analog circuits, we use high-performance elements that are used in high-end amplifiers based on technologies developed by Aurex.The design emphasizes sound quality through the parallel use of u Ï‰ -II type capacitors with low impedance, reduced contact between dissimilar metals, and improved vibration prevention, butyl-wound copper and styrene capacitors, butyl-wound copper and styrene capacitors, large-capacity GU capacitors (6.8 Ï‰ F/100V), and high-quality electrolytic capacitors.Toshiba, Sony, and Sanyo have jointly developed three types of LSI for digital signal processing of PCM audio encoder and decoder whose format was standardized by EIAJ in March 1981. This LSI is also used in the XD-80.This LSI is equipped with an ADSD circuit and an ASSC circuit to enable stable data extraction, and is equipped with a triple error detection method and error correction / correction method.Since it supports both 14-bit and 16-bit systems, it can be used not only for 14-bit systems in the EIAJ standard format but also for 16-bit systems for business use.With this newly developed LSI, it is possible to replace digital signal processing circuits that used to use hundreds of ICs with three different types of LSIs."

description: "An adres-capable cassette deck equipped with MQSS mechanism.Equipped with MQSS mechanism that can be used for head-tracking.When you want to listen to the next song during playback, this function detects the unrecorded portion before the next song and stops if you fast-forward with it turned ON. This function can also be used when rewinding.This switch also turns ON the MPX filter to prevent malfunction during air check.A 2-motor IC logic new simple mechanism is used for the mechanism part.In this mechanism, the capstan and reel stand are driven by independent motors to simplify the mechanism. In addition, by setting independent back tension for both constant speed and high-speed operation, slack of the tape is prevented and stability is improved. This back tension is also used for braking, and smooth stop is possible. Compared with the general two motor system in which a dedicated capstan motor is used for both the winding and reel drive. This system is simpler than the conventional two motor system in which a dedicated capstan motor is used for both the winding and reel drive.In addition, while reducing the number of rotating parts in the drive system, the accuracy of each part is also improved to ensure stability and quietness when the tape runs. This reduces the modulation noise of 200 Hz or higher generated by the modulation of the original signal caused by the tape or mechanical vibration.IC logic control system is adopted in the operation part, and direct changes such as from fast forward to rewind and from rewind to play can be performed.The recording / reproducing head uses an AS (All Sendust) head with a margin for maximum magnetic flux density. This head has a gap length of 1.0 microns to improve high-frequency characteristics.Also, an AF head is used for the erasing head.The read / write amplifier has a DC configuration without a coupling capacitor from each circuit.In addition, we have reduced hum and noise by making recording and re-switching electronic and rationalizing the wiring and layout of each board.Equipped with a pause / mute function that allows you to create a non-recording part with one touch by pressing the pause button.Timer standby mechanism is adopted.Auto repeat is possible.Equipped with a wide range peak meter that covers -40dB to + 10 dB.Equipped with a 4-stage tape selector with simultaneous Bias/EQ switching.Equipped with an ASO sensor using a magnetic sensitive semiconductor.Equipped with a tape counter.Compatible with optional remote control."

D. motor.As a noise reduction system, it is equipped with an adres unique to Aurex.As for adres, the hissing, which was a major drawback of the cassette, has been greatly reduced, while at the same time the dynamic range has been expanded to achieve higher sound quality, while avoiding bleeding noise and distortion.The capstan drive motor employs a flat-faced FG servo slot and coreless DC motor that rotates while the rotor is appropriately attracted to the stator coil side. name: PC-X88AD
description: "An adres loaded 3-head cassette deck that can also be used as an adres unit.Both recording and reproducing heads have excellent head touch and use a new type combination head with less level fluctuation. The head for recording is larger than that for reproducing heads to improve the bias characteristics. Moreover, the contour is reduced by the unique tip shape. The recording head is configured to ensure that the tape pad is in contact with the recording head. In addition, by adding a tension mechanism to the erasing head part, appropriate tension is applied and good head touch is obtained.Super AP with excellent bias efficiency and frequency characteristics is used for the head material.The PC-X88AD is equipped with an adres as a noise reduction system. The PC-X88AD has an adres for recording and playback separately built-in enabling simultaneous recording and monitoring.In addition, Dolby NR is also a double system, and recording simultaneous monitoring is possible.The mechanism uses 2-motor IC logic and new simple mechanism which inherited the idea of simple and silent mechanism.In this mechanism, the capstan drive and the reel base drive are each driven by independent motors using a simple two motor system. In particular, by using a motor with less cocking for the reel base motor, torque unevenness is improved.In addition, the automatic reverse take-up mechanism, which changes the take-up direction according to the motor rotation direction, uses a swing-head gear drive mechanism instead of the conventional reverse idler method. By adopting a high-precision gear and a design that does not require friction in the reverse mechanism, the rotational control ability of the motor for driving the reel table is improved.In addition, the main rotating shaft is laid out on the same chassis to improve the accuracy of the rotating system. In addition, independent back tension is set for constant-speed and high-speed driving to prevent the tape from sagging to improve driving stability. This back tension is also used for bluffing, making it possible to stop smoothly.It can also be used as a 4-channel adres unit and can be connected to your deck for adres recording. In this case, set the switch to the EXT DECK/CAL position and use the CAL adjustment volume to calibrate with the deck. If you set the switch to the ADJ position, the CAL adjustment volume can adjust the level of the PC-X88AD when decoding an adres tape encoded by another unit.The power supply section consists of a total of 13 constant voltage circuits, including 6 ¥2 electric Minamoto no Sadamu voltage circuits (adres recording / playback, Dolby recording / playback, 2 amplifier circuits) and a constant voltage circuit for mechanical devices.The read head is directly connected to a differential configuration DC equalizer amplifier using Igm dual FET 2SK-150 to reduce distortion and improve the SN ratio.You can play back the adres record.In this case, the switch is set to the adres disk position, the Adres CAL TONE seat is placed on the player, and the reference level of the adres is taken. This is done on the Recording Master Volume, and the reference level can be adjusted with one touch by setting the level marker on the Recording Master Volume.In addition to 4-step simultaneous switching of bias and equalizer, it is equipped with a bias fine adjustment function which can change the bias value subtly.When the input selector switch is set to the OSC position, a 1 kHz frequency signal can be input as a test signal. This allows the recording sensitivity adjustment (SENS (REC)) knob to be adjusted to maintain a constant recording / playback level for each tape.In addition to auto rewind and auto repeat, memory rewind / stop and memory repeat can be performed with the memory counter.Equipped with a timer standby mechanism, you can record your absence or play an alarm clock by connecting an audio timer (sold separately).The REC mute function works as long as the Pause button is pressed, and the moment you release the Pause button, the Pause button is activated.It has an output volume.The microphone terminal is mounted on the back.Compatible with optional remote control."

name: SY-LAMBD¥8II
description: "A control amplifier announced as an improved version of SY-? 88.The newly developed stabilized super Ï‰ power supply is used for the power supply to reduce the impedance between the AC power supply and the amplifier. name: SC-LAMBDA90F
description: "This is a stereo power amplifier developed for the digital audio age based on the technology developed in the SC-? 99 and SY-? 88 II.Equipped with newly developed complimentary service power MOS FET.This power MOS FET (2SK405, 2SJ115) developed by Aurex employs a double diffusion structure called � -MOS, which realizes high voltage resistance, high gain, and high speed.In addition, it realizes high power by keeping the on-resistance low at the same time. Moreover, conventional driver circuits can be used as they are, and parallel use is easy.The newly developed power MOS FET is connected in parallel, the first stage dual FET cascode connection, the second stage dual transistor differential cascode connection, and the Darlington connection at the current mirror voltage amplification stage for driving.The input stage employs 2SK270A, a low-noise dual FET used in the SY - Ï‰ 88 II and SC - Ï‰ 99. In addition, a super Ï‰ power supply, which is well known for its low-noise and low-impedance over a wide band, is introduced to suppress noise in the power supply.In addition, a low-noise driver circuit is designed to reduce internal resistance and prevent thermal noise by allowing sufficient current to flow through the semiconductor element, resulting in an excellent S / N ratio.In order to promote low noise and low impedance between the AC power supply and the amplifier, a super Ï‰ power supply is used in the power supply section up to the pre-driver stage to improve sound quality.A large 410 VA toroidal transformer is used for the power transformer. The secondary winding consists of three separate power sources for power amplification, voltage amplification (driver circuit), protection circuit and indicator, reducing mutual interference.In order to reduce the impedance, the power switch has a large capacity and a rectifier is used in parallel. The rectifier is a high-speed type and the terminal is covered with silver cladding.A high-quality large-capacity large-capacity electrolytic capacitor developed in the SC - Ï‰ 99 is used in the circuit for the power amplifier stage. In addition, a newly developed electrolytic capacitor is used in the Super Ï‰ power supply for the driver amplifier stage. Each electrolytic capacitor is connected in parallel with a u Ï‰ -II type Ï‰ capacitor, a copper foil styrene capacitor, a V-capacitor, etc., so that low impedance, reduction of contact between dissimilar metals, and prevention of vibration are greatly improved.Unlike general DC amplifiers, this DC amplifier is designed as a servo-less DC amplifier to prevent degradation of sound quality caused by DC servo circuits containing active elements.As a result, the feedback circuit that affects sound quality is simplified, and excellent music playback is possible even at high output.The basic signal circuit has a very simple structure, and high-reliability carbon resistance called RM resistance is used in parallel for the resistance of the NFB loop and each signal system. By making the resistance different from each resistance value, the frequency of noise is dispersed, coloring caused by the noise of resistance is eliminated, and the flatness of audibility is taken into consideration.In addition, where non-linear components of the transistor are generated, capacitors made of copper foil styrene capacitors wrapped with butyl rubber to prevent vibration are used to suppress the noise of the capacitors.As solid capacitors for the signal and power supply systems, we have adopted copper foil styrene capacitors, u Ï‰ -II type Ï‰ capacitors, GU capacitors, etc., which have the same reputation as Ï‰ 99. In addition to low impedance, we greatly promote reduction of contact between dissimilar metals and vibration prevention.In addition, a special manufacturing method has been used to reduce resonance over a wide band and to realize characteristics with good energy balance.As the source resistance of the power MOS FET at the output stage, we have adopted a Ï‰ resistor made of copper, which was also used for Ï‰ 99. As a result, all the paths through which a large current flows are unified with elements using copper, and a Ï‰ loop circuit that does not mix dissimilar metals is achieved.Equipped with a large peak power meter, monitoring is possible without range switching.The brightness of the meter can be changed in 2 levels.Equipped with two input terminals, direct and variable.The variable terminal allows volume control with the front volume control switch, and the volume position can be confirmed by the 5-point LED on the front panel.The direct input jack directly connects to the first stage of the amplifier without passing through the input volume.It is equipped with Aurex's unique clean drive circuit.A third cord connected to the negative terminal of the speaker detects the distortion component caused by the nonlinear component of the back electromotive force and feeds it back into the amplifier to cancel the distortion. This reduces harmonic distortion to less than 1/10, greatly reduces intermodulation distortion, provides flat frequency characteristics, makes the impedance of the speaker cord 0, and has an infinite damping factor.The Clean Drive terminal is designed to be connected to the negative terminal side of the speaker for maximum power. In case of emergency, it is equipped with a low-speed protection circuit to protect the set from incorrect connection.In addition to the conventional protection circuit that protects the amplifier when DC voltage leaks into the speaker output terminal or the speaker is short-circuited, a temperature protection circuit is also installed to protect the set from abnormal high temperature inside the set and prevent thermal runaway."

name: SC-LAMBDA99
description: "This is a stereo power amplifier that pursues sound quality in all aspects such as Ï‰ power supply, Ï‰ loop, chassis structure, parts and internal layout.Pure class A operation and class AB operation can be selected for SC-? 99 by switching the switch.In pure class A operation, there is no degradation of sound quality because the distortion is not avoided by varying the bias as in a pseudo class A amplifier. Moreover, the best characteristics of the element can be drawn out because the bias point is placed at the best point of the amplifying element.In class AB operation, the super fTThe use of power transistors and low-distortion circuits reduces switching distortion to an undetectable level.The circuit configuration is a fully symmetrical type with dual FET differential cascode connection, three stage Darlington connection, and triple parallel output stage. The power transistor is a super f of Pc150W.TBy using a power transistor, we can obtain an allowable input with a margin, and by keeping the capacity and number of high-frequency phase correction capacitors small, we have succeeded in obtaining stable gain up to the high-frequency range.One chip low-noise dual FETs (2SK90A-Nch, 2SJ90A-Pch) with excellent thermal balance are used in a fully symmetrical form. The input stage to the output stage are operated symmetrically to reduce the distortion factor. In addition, in order to ensure stable operation up to the ultra-high frequency range, all the amplification stages are configured as two stage amplification circuits by cascode connection. This improves the SN ratio by 7 to 8 dB compared to the conventional one. 270When the speaker is driven, the diaphragm moves and a back electromotive force flows into the amplifier and distorts the speaker input signal. The SC-? 99 has a high damping factor of 500 and low output impedance, reducing the influence of the back electromotive force of the speaker.Uses Aurex's unique super Ï‰ power supply.In class A operation, the collector output impedance of the power stage, driver stage and pre-driver stage becomes small, so that the influence of the impedance of the power supply part appears. In SC-? 99, the super Ï‰ power source adopted in SY-? 88II is developed to promote low impedance between AC power source and amplifier, and is adopted in the power supply part up to the pre-driver stage. This realizes ultra-low impedance and low noise of only 0.5m � from DC to 100 kHz.The central part of the super Ï‰ power supply section is simplified by using one stage differential, and the power supply section is provided with sufficient space by using parallel control power transistors.In addition, two large and small transformers, a large power toroidal transformer and a driver toroidal transformer, are installed to further improve sound quality.In order to achieve low impedance, the power switch is of large capacity, and rectifiers, newly developed electrolytic capacitors and various film capacitors are used in parallel.Newly developed large-scale electrolytic capacitors for power supply are used. They are equipped with 18,000 Ï‰ F/80Vx4, 1.000 Ï‰ F/80Vx4, 820 Ï‰ F/80Vx8, and 560 Ï‰ F/100Vx4. In addition to low impedance, we are also working to reduce contact with dissimilar metals and prevent vibration. Solid capacitors for signal and power supply systems include copper foil styrene capacitors, u Ï‰ -II type Ï‰ capacitors, and copper foil film capacitors. In particular, film capacitors are manufactured by a special manufacturing method to suppress resonance over a wide range and realize high sound quality with little distortion. Electrolytic capacitors are also manufactured by a special manufacturing method based on consideration of film capacitors, and achieve an excellent energy balance.A high-purity oxygen-free copper 280 Ï‰ m thick glass epoxy board is used for all printed circuit boards except for the indicator part. This reduces vibration by increasing the weight of the board while achieving low impedance.As the emitter resistor of the output stage, a Ï‰ loop including a Ï‰ resistor using copper as a resistor is adopted, so that all the paths for large current flow are unified with elements using copper.Two large extruded aluminum heat sinks are attached to the heat pipe that uses the heat of vaporization. name: SB-66
description: "Pre-main amplifier with clean drive.It is equipped with Aurex's unique clean drive.In the Clean Drive method, a distortion component detection code is added to the negative terminal side of the speaker. This detects the distortion component generated in the speaker and feeds it back into the amplifier. Then, the feedback amount is adjusted to cancel the distortion component in the amplifier. This eliminates the distortion caused by the transmission characteristics of the speaker cable and the back electromotive force generated in the speaker, and improves the dynamic characteristics.Since there is almost no current flow in this detection cord, there is no voltage drop, and the distortion component can be detected at the speaker terminal. Since the cord also detects the impedance with the speaker cable, the voltage at the speaker input terminal becomes equal to the output voltage of the amplifier, and it is a constant voltage drive.By adopting this clean drive method, the harmonic distortion factor when connected to a speaker is reduced to less than 1 / 10, and intermodulation distortion is also greatly improved. In addition, since the impedance of the amplifier and the speaker cable can be completely cancelled, the impedance seen from the speaker input terminal toward the amplifier is 0, and the damping factor at the speaker input terminal is infinite.The power amplifier section has a simple DC configuration by eliminating capacitors from the signal path that cause sound quality degradation.Superf for power transistorsTThe transistor has a transition frequency of 70 a high transition frequency of 70 MHz and can be amplified up to high frequencies. In addition, the switching time is short and the switching distortion is kept to a level that is practically insignificant.In addition, it has excellent linearity and reduced crossover distortion. Moreover, it is possible to drive with sufficient power by securing sufficient ASO (safe operation region) which is important as a power transistor.It uses a VX capacitor which is an improved version of the V capacitor used in the SY-88.In the VX capacitor, the distance between the electrodes is made shorter to realize low impedance and the vibration mode is simplified to minimize the induction of electrical noise.The equalizer amplifier section is a high-gain equalizer, and both MM and MC cartridges can be used by changing the gain.The tone control section is configured so that when the tone volume is set to the center, the tone is lost.It uses a heat sinker that is small but has a large radiator plate area.In addition to the normal protector, a high-speed protector for the clean drive circuit is mounted.Even if the distortion detection code for the clean drive is miswired, the protector operates immediately and the clean drive circuit is protected."

name: Toshiba
description: "A flagship DVD video / audio player that supports both DVD video and DVD audio.Two discs can be set in the SD 5000.Video partThe video DAC uses a high-performance 10-bit / 54 MHz video D/A converter.By drastically increasing the processing speed of the video DAC from 10-bit / 27-MHz to 54 MHz, it is possible to perform high-speed arithmetic processing with more latitude. With this function, when a DVD is played back, a rough indication of the amount of data transferred for each image can be displayed on the screen using numbers and a level bar.Equipped with high-quality letterbox conversion circuit.When you play a 16 : 9 DVD video on a 4 : 3 TV, a letterbox conversion is performed to convert the original video, which consists of 480 effective lines, to 360 lines (360 lines) without the Kuroobi portion.This conversion circuit uses a 4-tap vertical filter developed in-house. It calculates four original scanning lines at high speed and generates new lines with uniform characteristics. As a result, higher quality images can be reproduced than the conventional letterbox image quality.It is equipped with an optimum servo that realizes stable playback by adapting to the disc condition.Auto Pause Mode automatically controls the still image display according to the state.The S-Video output is mounted.Audio partThe D/A converter uses a high-performance audio DAC for the front two channels developed jointly with Analog Devices, Inc. of the United States, which is an improvement over the conventional Advanced Multi-bit Delta-Sigma DAC.A multi-bit system with high jitter tolerance and low noise is combined with a 1-bit system with excellent linearity and no 0 cross distortion. The increase of differential linearity error is reduced by an advanced error averaging circuit between elements.It has a built-in Dolby Digital 5.1 ch decoder and DTS decoder.Equipped with an HDCD decoder.Equipped with the Specializer N-2-2 Digital Virtual Surround System, which can reproduce powerful three dimensional sound images with 2 speakers.OtherIt is equipped with a V-Remote function that can be operated using a virtual remote control displayed on the TV screen. From this menu, you can switch between memory playback, repeat playback, random playback, bit rate display and text display ON/OFF, etc.Equipped with NAVI function.When you press the NAVI button on the remote control, the NAVI screen which displays icons of each function and disk information on the screen starts up.
